Bond Bell
Ringing
His Excellency the President of the Republic of Kenya, Hon. Mwai Kibaki C.G.H MP
presides over the Bell Ringing Ceremony for the Bond Issue which raised Kshs. 7
billion against a target of Kshs. 5 billion, an overwhelming over-subscription of 41%.
